descriptions.d24i_teleport_message_80119470: Teleport weapon message handler: message 64 forwards to the base handler and runs setup 0x80119590 on success, returning 0x80004005 on failure; message 66 runs shutdown 0x801196d8 and forwards to the base handler; the cached message 0x804af32c either starts the jump 0x80119794 when test 0x80119aa8 passes or posts an 8-byte arena notification; the cached message 0x804af31c runs 0x8015fd1c; all others go to the base handler.
